basic_details.job_title: ABV IIITM Intern Recruitment 2026 – Apply Online
basic_details.short_information: Five Intern positions are open at ABV-IIITM Gwalior on the I-DAPT Hub Foundation sponsored project "Design and Development of Edge-Al Enabled Multimodal Smart Health Monitoring System for Early Anomaly Detection", under Dr. Anjali. The stipend is up to Rs. 5000 a month. Candidates who are pursuing or have completed B.Tech. in an area related to the project must upload a detailed CV to a Google form by 12 November 2026. The internship is for 6 months initially and may be extended up to 12 months or the project duration, whichever is earlier.

content_sections.heading: ABV-IIITM Intern at a Glance
content_sections.text: The official notification does not specify the age limit or the application fee.

rows.details: Atal Bihari Vajpayee-Indian Institute of Information Technology & Management (ABV-IIITM), Gwalior
Design and Development of Edge-Al Enabled Multimodal Smart Health Monitoring System for Early Anomaly Detection (I-DAPT/IIT (BHU)/2025-26/Project Sanction/37)
Initially 6 months, extendable up to 12 months or the duration of the project, whichever is earlier

content_sections.heading: About ABV-IIITM
content_sections.text: ABV-IIITM Gwalior describes itself in the notice as an autonomous institute under MHRD, Govt. of India. The internship sits in a project supervised by Dr. Anjali, Assistant Professor (IT). The Principal Investigators are Dr. Anjali and Dr. Mahendra Kumar Shukla. The project aims to develop an Edge-AI enabled multimodal smart health monitoring system that integrates ECG, PPG, IMU and temperature sensors for continuous physiological monitoring and early anomaly detection. The proposed Cyber-Physical System performs real-time, low-latency analytics on edge devices using lightweight AI models, with secure Edge–Cloud connectivity.

content_sections.heading: Who Can Apply
content_sections.text: Essential qualification: candidates should be either pursuing or should have completed B.Tech. in any area related to the project. Desirable qualification: prior work in either of the following: Machine Learning (Anomaly Detection, etc.), especially with the creation of custom datasets. Projects involving Raspberry Pi and Arduino implementation. The candidates will be required to meet the investigators physically at least on a weekly basis. Therefore, only candidates stationed at Gwalior will be considered. For the discipline-specific eligibility, candidates should refer to the official notification.

content_sections.heading: Pay and Tenure
content_sections.text: The monthly stipend is up to Rs. 5000, subject to submission of monthly progress reports and meeting monthly targets. The position carries no HRA, hostel, fooding or any other allowance other than the nominal stipend. The duration is initially 6 months. It is extendable up to 12 months or the duration of the project, whichever is earlier. The notice also says the extension runs up to the remaining duration of the project, subject to availability of funds.

content_sections.heading: How to Apply for ABV-IIITM Intern
content_sections.text: Open the Google form given in the notice (link in the Important Links table below). Upload a detailed CV that includes academic details with percentage/CGPA. Include research works/projects in the CV. Include internship/work experience, if any. Submit before the application deadline of 12 November 2026. For any query about the position, e-mail Dr. Anjali at [email protected] .

content_sections.heading: Selection and Interview
content_sections.text: Only shortlisted candidates will be informed by e-mail about the interview date. The interview will be conducted in person, in offline mode, at ABV-IIITM Gwalior. The notice does not give the interview date.
